description: Smoke/sample fixture for the hex-detection eval harness: 18 Holo Taco and Mooncat shades. The image under evaluation is the first Shopify product image (what ingestion sends to the model); the ground truth was measured from a different vendor photo of painted nails (see each case's notes). It is a curated sample, not vendor-published hex data — regenerate from color_training_sample with `npm run eval:hex:populate` once trusted vendor hexes exist.
